remaining_nonexpert_work.action: Discover and register authoritative Eteocypriot inscriptions and editions beyond the frozen source set.
Link shared Cypriot inscription identities and museum or catalogue IDs without duplicating witnesses.
Encode source-attributed alternative readings and edition lineage.

human_only_boundary.decision: adjudicate Eteocypriot versus Greek component or language attribution where disputed
adjudicate damaged or restored readings and segmentation
independent epigraphic review and linguistic interpretation

completion_rule: All machine and source-discoverable expansion work must be completed or explicitly access-blocked; language attribution, disputed readings and interpretation remain human decisions.

historical_concordance_checkpoint.remaining: Inspect further primary editions, resolve historical/modern identity and attribution differences, and acquire item-level sources for discovery leads. This is not terminal whole-corpus readiness.
